scope.scope: One isolated mechanism: early defender kicks/body contacts in shot prediction and shot fallback ranking. No formation, marking, receiver support, goal-protection or player-attribute changes.
scope.diagnostic_cases: Reproduced v7 false-safe shots from build9 loss inspection; these already-examined games are regression cases, never fresh evidence.
scope.selection: Development-only 64 then240 paired matches; compare early contact forecast versus forecast+fallback alternatives. Freeze before672 paired fresh matches. Prefer match points and no reproducible policy errors.
scope.fresh: 14 frozen opponent sources,12 unused seeds,4 arrangements,2400ticks,20ms; publish raw interruptions and first clean exact repeats independent of outcome.
